title: Rovers
spec: 6 wheels: rocker-bogie → aluminium extrusion · 2× BTS7960 · GPS/compass · then a 4-wheel rebuild
summary: A lockdown rover inspired by the Mars rovers. The 3D-printed rocker-bogie had too many parts and wobbly joints, so I rebuilt it on aluminium extrusion; the plan was autonomy with ArduPilot, until I fried the magnetometer. A four-wheel Rover 2 followed at university in 2022, and got paused when AeroDesign took over.

cover.alt: Rover 2's SolidWorks model: a box chassis with an electronics bay, a fan cover and red-hubbed wheels
